description: The order \([A]\leq[B]\) holds exactly when every valuation satisfying \(A\) satisfies \(B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.class_le_iff.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf A ≤
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf B ↔
    ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v A = true →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v B = true
